model.name: Bahl et al. 2012 reduced L5 pyramidal cell, single-compartment soma (pyr_cell)
model.citation: Bahl A, Stemmler MB, Herz AVM, Roth A (2012). Automated optimization of a reduced layer 5 pyramidal cell model based on experimental data. Journal of Neuroscience Methods 210(1):22-34. doi:10.1016/j.jneumeth.2012.04.006
model.license: unclear (no LICENSE/LICENCE/COPYING file in the tree at this commit; GitHub licence API: none)
model.expected_behavior: Single segment (d = L = 23.15 um). pas 0.0486, kfast 6.72, kslow 47.6, nat 23.7, nap 0.144, km 1.05 mS/cm2 (given in S/m2); Cm 2.23 uF/cm2; no Ih in this soma-only cell (the multicompartment pyr.cell.nml has dendritic Ih). Harness: +0.4 nA 100-600 ms. Shipped NEURON reference used by the jNeuroML OMV test (NEURON/test/.test.mep, threshold -30 mV): 3 spikes at 102.1, 112.5 and 131.8 ms, then none for the rest of the step (phasic / strongly adapting). Not simulated in this sweep.
model.inclusion_reason: Behaviourally distinct (onset spikes then silence, from slow K), from an optimisation-based publication; jNeuroML OMV test (check-runs at this commit: jNeuroML success; the NEURON:8.2.6 job failed). BLOCKER: no licence, so it cannot be redistributed in the study repository without permission (fetch at run time or ask the authors). The cell file name lacks the .cell.nml suffix.
